name: MAISON DE MORPHO
source:
A young man who was mentally ill and didn't meet other people ended up working at a sanatorium for children who couldn't go to school. The destination he was taken to was a Western-style building towering deep in the mountains. The boys who live there have very different appearances and special constitutions from humans.

Unravel the mysteries of a strange sanatorium while interacting with nonhuman boys.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7618]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一个患有心理疾病、不与人来往的青年，机缘巧合之下，来到一间收留无法上学的孩子的疗养院工作。他被带往的目的地，是深山中一幢高耸的西式建筑。住在那里的少年们，外貌与人类大不相同，还拥有特殊的体质。

与非人少年们交流，揭开这间奇异疗养院的谜团。

[译自 [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7618]NovelGame[/url]]
